tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa'am mngon rtogs nye bar bsdus pa bzhugs/

na ma shrī kā la tsakrā ya/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po padma dang*/ /zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor/ /zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ /lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gi padma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma bsreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma ru/ /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang*/ /dril bu phub dang kha ṭwāṃ thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'khyud gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍā ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /thod pa zhags pa padma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud/ /nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan dan gur gum dang ni ga pur snod/ /dril bu padma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdub bu ste/ / g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen sna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/

/g.yon na bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras chan snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍā ma ru/ /pi wang rnga dang 'khar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud/ /tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen sgrub dga' ba bzhis/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa/ /skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi/ /chos kyi dung dang gaṇḍi nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs chen dri chu dri chen rab 'gags pas/ /'chi med rab ster 'chi med rgyun gyis mngon par gang ba'i thod pa'am/ /zla ba'i rang bzhin zla ba'i 'od ltar rab tu dkar ba'i bum pa ni/ /bdud kyi tshogs 'joms bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis shin tu gang ba rnams la 'dud/ /'du byed rlung dang ngag gi dbang po sna dang reg gzhan 'dus ma byas/ /don yod sgrol ma bgegs kyi sgra dang nam mkha'i snying po reg bya ma/ /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum phub dang dpal ldan thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /nyi zla'i gdong ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs sa yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /tshor ba me dang lag pa'i dbang po mig dang ro gzhan bde ba che/ /rin chen dbang po gos dkar mo dang rmugs byed sa yi snying po ro/ /mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma ru dang gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu'i phyag/dkar nag gdong ldan nyin mor byed 'dra chu yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ / 'du shes chu dang rkang pa'i dbang po lce dang gzugs gzhan ye shes sku/

/snang ba mtha' yas mā ma kī dang khengs byed 'jig rten dbang po'i gzugs/ /tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum pad dkar me long dang ni bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /nag dang dmar ba'i gdong ldan dkar po me yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /gzugs kyi phung po sa dang bshang lam lus dang dri gzhan 'od gsal gzugs/ /rtag pa spyan ma rengs byed dang ni rnam sel dri yi rdo rje ma/ /'khor lo dbyug pa khro bo'i rdo rje dung dang lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan gser gyi ri 'dra rlung gi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /rna ba chos khams yid dang sgra gzhan phyag na rdo rje chos khams ma/ /kun bzang sgra yi rdo rje ma ste ljang sngon phan tshun yang dag sbyor/ /g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i zhal gyis rab brgyan rdo rje gri gug dgra sta dang*/ /dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i gdong ldan stong pa'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dkar chu skyes mdangs bkra'i ze 'brur 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje'i gdan dang g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs rgyal dang rgyas sras khro rgyal dang*/ /'dam skyes dmar po'i ge sar snying por ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /padma'i gdan bzhugs rig ma rnams dang rdo rje ma rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar lha yi 'khor lo legs mchod dri dang 'phreng ba bdug spos ma/ /snang gsal bdud rtsi 'bras bu ma dang sgeg mo bzhad ma sil snyan ma/ / gar dang glu yi sbyor ba la brtson 'dod ma 'dod la rab dga' ma/ /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur du mas yid rab 'dzin ma rnams bstod do/ /phyogs dang mtshams su chu skyes dmar dang dkar po la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /lte ba'i rtsa brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i chos can ma/ /thun tshod dang ni dbyug gu rnam dag kun nas bde la snyoms 'jug ma/ /spyan gsum phyag bzhi rol pas yongs bskor sa ga'i stabs kyis legs gnas ma/ /yi dwags la gnas tsartsi ka ni dbang pos 'khyud cing 'jigs ma dang*/

/rlung shugs ma dang drag mo dus kyi mche ba ma dang me 'bar gdong*/ /rab gtum drag mig sna chen mas bskor dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zla zhal ma/ /thams cad gri gug rtse gsum thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga yis brgyan la 'dud/ /mkha' lding la gnas khyab 'jug ma ni tshangs pas 'khyud cing dpal mo dang*/ /rnam par rgyal ma sgyu ma grags ma bkra shis ma dang dpal rgyal ma/ /dpal rgyal byed ma 'khor lo mas bskor 'khor lo dbyug tho padma dang*/ /dung gi phyag ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma her gnas pa'i phag mo la ni drag pos 'khyud cing keng rus ma// rtsigs ma dus mtshan rab khros gdong ma dus kyi lce ma nag mo dang*/ /drag mo dang ni gzugs ngan mas bskor me yi mdog can zla zhal ma/ /dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog phub kyis rnam brgyan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rma byar gnas pa'-i gzhon nu ma ni tshogs bdag gis 'khyud padma ma/ /rin chen phreng ma lus med gzhon nu ri dwags bdag po'i 'gros ma dang*/ /mig mdzes rul ma bzang mos yongs bskor byi ru'i 'od 'phro gdong drug ma/ /shaka ti lcags kyu rin chen zhags pas nye bar mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyu mchog la gnas drag mo la ni gshin rjes 'khyud cing phyogs kun nas/ /gau ri 'degs ma gaṃ ga ma dang rtag ma myur ma mtshon byed ma/ /dmar ser ma dang nag mos yongs bskor zla ba'i mdog can zla ba'i zhal/ /rtse gsum cang te'u kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ltos 'gros mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ger gnas pa'i dpal mo la ni gzhon nus 'khyud cing dpal dkar mo/ /'dzin ma zla ba'i ri mo can dang ri bong 'dzin zhal ngang pa'i mdog /padma'i dbang mo skar mig ma dang dri med ri bong 'dzin mas bskor/ /zla 'od zla zhal padma bgrang 'phreng chu skyes rin chen 'dzin la 'dud/ /glang por gnas pa'i dbang mo la ni srin pos 'khyud cing rdo rje'i 'od/ /bkra ba'i ri mo rdo rje'i lus ma gser ldan ma dang ur ba si/

/raṃ bha zug rngu med ma dang ni shin tu sgrol mas yongs bskor ma/ /gser mdog zla zhal rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu yis mtshan la 'dud/ /ngang par gnas pa'i tshangs ma la ni nor lhas 'khyud cing mchod sbyin 'dod/ /ngag gi dbang phyug padma'i spyan ma chu skyes ldan ma blo gros ma/ /glu ma glog ma dran mas yongs bskor rig byed gdong ma gser mdog ma/ / phyag gi padmas padma tshangs dbyug spyi blugs bar bus mtshan la 'dud/ /zla ba tshigs chen nyi ma'i tshes dang rtsa/ /rnam dag lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan gsum nyi zla'i mdog can padma'i steng*/ /rol pas yongs bskor rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /srin mos 'khyud cing yi dwags la gnas pa'i/ / bden bral la sogs nag pa'i tshes rnams gzhan/ /ral gri gri gug phub dang thod pa can/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zla ba'i zhal la 'dud/ /gtum mos 'khyud cing ri dwags la gnas pa'i/ /rlung sogs sa ga'i tshes gzhan dpag bsam shing*/ /yongs 'dus me tog nor bu utpal 'dzin/ /zla zhal mig sman mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lug la gnas shing chu bdag mos 'khyud pa'i/ /me lha la sogs snron gyi tshes rnams gzhan/ /mdung thung dbyug pa chu skyes spyi blugs 'dzin/ /zhal gcig padma rā ga'i mdog la 'dud/ /dpal mos 'khyud cing rma bya la gnas pa'i/ /gdong drug la sogs chu stod tshes rnams gzhan/ /shaka ti mdung dang nor bu me long can/ /byi ru'i 'od 'phro gdong drug ldan pas skyong*/ / phag mos 'khyud cing chu srin la gnas pa'i/ /rgya mtsho la sogs gro bzhin tshes rnams gzhan/ /zhags pa rin chen sbrul zhags chu shel 'dzin/ /zla ba'i 'od can zla ba'i zhal mchod do/ /byi bar gnas shing gzhon nu mas 'khyud pa'i/ / tshogs bdag la sogs khrums stod chos rnams gzhan/ /dgra st+wa rdo rje zhags pa nor bu'i phyag /zla zhal zla 'od lta bur dkar la 'dud/ /glang por gnas shing rlung lha mos 'khyud pa'i/

/brgya byin la sogs tha skar tshes rnams gzhan/ /rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu yis mtshan/ /gser mdog zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glog mas 'khyud cing ngang pa las gnas pa'i/ /tshangs pa la sogs smin drug tshes rnams gzhan/ /khab dang bgrang 'phreng chu skyes spyi blugs 'dzin/ /chu yi gser mtshungs chu yi zhal gyis skyong*/ /u mas 'khyud cing khyu mchog la gnas pa'i/ /drag po la sogs mgo yi tshes rnams gzhan/ /rtse gsum mda' dang sbrul ldan kha ṭāṃ gzhu/ /ri bong 'dzin zhal mkha' ltar sngo la 'dud/ /glang por gnas shing nor sbyin mas 'khyud pa'i/ /nor bdag la sogs rgyal gyi tshes rnams gzhan/ /nor bu be con ne'u le padma'i phyag /sngon po ri dwags mtshan pa'i zhal mchod bgyi/ /dpal mos 'khyud cing mkha' lding la gnas pa'i/ /khyab 'jug la sogs mchu yi tshes rnams gzhan/ /'khor lo dbyug tho padma dung gis mtshan/ /zhal gcig mar gad mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje mas 'khyud ma he la gnas pa'i/ /gshin rje la sogs dbo yi tshes rnams gzhan/ /dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog zhags pas brgyan/ /ljang khu ri dwags can zhal la phyag 'tshal/ /'od zer can 'khyud dbyug sngon nag po ral gri dang ni rdo rje phub dang ltos 'gro 'dzin/ /tsin das legs 'khyud ḍā ki dmar po me mda' dang ni lcags kyu gzhu dang zhags pas mtshan/ /khro gnyer mas 'khyud mi g.yo dkar po tho ba dang ni mdung dang padma me long 'dzin/ /lcags sgrog mas 'khyud stobs chen ser po 'khor lo dang ni dbyug pa dung dang nor bu'i phyag /sngon mos 'khyud pa'i gtsug tor ljang khu dgra st+wa dang ni rtse gsum sbrul zhags kha ṭwāṃ ga /drag spyan mas 'khyud gnod mdzes sngon po gri gug dang ni rdo rje thod pa dril bu 'dzin/ /phag rta seng ge glang po mkha' lding rkang brgyad kyi ni shing rta la gnas g.yas brkyang stabs/ /mthil bzhi bshang lam gtsug gi rtsa dag khro bo'i tshogs ni zhal gcig phyag bzhis brjid la 'dud/

/stobs kyi rgyu dang padma char sprin mdog /nor rgyas dung skyong byi ru'i phung po 'dra/ /mtha' yas rigs ldan kun da'i mdog ltar gsal/ /'jog po padma chen po rab tu ser/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal ljang sngon 'byung ba la/ /rdo rje gdan bzhugs rin chen rgyal gyis brgyan/ /bum pa rdo rje padma nor bu'i phyag /rkang sor klu chen gtum mos 'khyud la 'dud/ /mdung gis 'bigs dang lhag ma brtsegs pa'i ro/ /drag po'i g.yul dang rul pa byis pa gsod/ /rnag gi dri dang sbrul gyis zos pa yis/ /dur khrod chen por bse dang bhe run ṭa/ /dom dang khrung khrung 'bri dang bya ma byi/ /seng ge mig sngon la gnas 'khor lo'i steng*/ /zlum po'i stabs can mi mgo'i 'phreng ldan ma/ /gcer bu spyan gsum gri gug thod pa ma/ /phyag rgya lnga ldan klu yis rab 'khyud ma/ /lus la lag pa'i ser mo rnam dag ma/ /khyi gdong ma dang khwa gdong phag gdong ma/ / bya rgod gdong ma stag gdong 'ug gdong ma/ /lce spyang gdong ma nam mkha' lding gdong ma/ /steng 'og shing rtar sngon mo rdo rje'i mig /skra dang ba spu rnam dag grub pa dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu stobs ma rmugs byed ma dang nga rgyal can ma rengs byed ma/ /lcags sgrog ma dang khro gnyer can ma tsun da dang ni 'od zer can/ /drag spyan ma dang shin tu sngon mo rang rang rigs kyi khro bo yi/ /zhal phyag mtshon cha kha dog rgyan ldan khro mo rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin sgrol ma reg bya ma dang khyab 'jug lcags sgrog kha gdong ma/ /rab sngon rab brtson tsartsi ka dang khyi gdong mas bskyed brgya byin du// dbye ba gos dang mchil 'dor reg bya lhag ma za ba kun du gdung*/ /skrod dang lus 'phrug yan lag bskyod par 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma la 'dud/ /gos dkar ro ma gzhon nu ma dang khro gnyer can ma bya rgod ma/ /drag spyan rmug ma phag mo dang ni phag gdong mas bskyed lho phyogs su/

/bskyod pa zas dang gar 'gugs g.yul dang rgyug pa dang ni skems pa dang*/ /lus kyi dri ma bshang gci zag par 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma rnams mchod/ /mā mā kī dang gzugs ma dpal mo tsun da dang ni 'ug gdong ma/ /sgra ma khengs ma drag mo dang ni stag gdong mas bskyed nor sbyin du/ /rgyas pa rgyan dang rgyal srid 'ching ba byis pa sdig dang rol mo'i sgra/ /'jam par smra dang mal stan rtsod mang 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma rnams rgyal/ /spyan ma dri ma tshangs ma dang ni 'od zer can ma mkha' lding ma/ /chos kyi khams ma rengs ma dbang mo lce spyang mas bskyed chu bdag tu/ / rengs pa dri dang chu la rkyal ba phur bus 'debs dang sbrul 'ching 'khrig /gnyen 'dun mal brnyes sems can bslu 'dod phyir 'dod ma rnams gzhan la 'dud/ /khyod ni srid pa gsum las 'das kyang srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa can/ / phra rab rdul gyi chos dang bral yang brtan dang g.yo ba kun gyi gzugs/ /lus dang dbang po'i sbyor ba spangs kyang rtag tu 'dod chags che la rol/ /bsam gyis mi khyab brtag par dka' ba dus kyi 'khor los bdag skyongs shig /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang*/ /ghaṇa ṭa karṇa dga' byed nag po che/ /bhṛṃ gi ni sogs 'khor mang rgyal gyur cig /de ltar bstod pas phung po khams sogs gzhan/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /glo bur dri ma'i sbugs las nges grol te/ /srid gsum dang ba mngon du byaid gyur cig /

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa'am mngon rtogs nye bar bsdus pa rdzogs so/ /sems can thams cad kyis rang rang la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rgyal khams phyogs med ris med pa rton pa bzhi ldan gyis bkod pa'o// //oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥswāhā/ maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa'am mngon rtogs nye bar bsdus pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 204--PAGE 205--PAGE 196-
